name: @nexus/installers
description: EP-042 M4 local installer (SPEC-016, SPEC-024): transactional install with backup-before-update, staged validation, atomic switch, rollback, quarantine, typed failure classification, abuse-case guards (path traversal, symlink escape, duplicate overwrite, foreign-root cleanup, forged receipts), append-only installer journal, redacted current-run observability, and an operations diagnostic + bounded recovery command. Canonical release/update truth remains in crates/nexus-release (M1) and apps/setup/src/update/ (M2); transport boundary in infra/release/ (M3).
